name: AO SMITH X2 Neo
summary: A. O. Smith X2 Neo is a premium 5-stage UV water purifier designed for homes using municipal water with TDS below 200 ppm .
intro: The A. O. Smith X2 Neo is a sleek and elegantly designed UV water purifier ideal for homes receiving municipal corporation water with TDS below 200 ppm. It features an advanced 5-stage purification system with UV, SCB Max Combination Filter, Silver Activated Post Carbon (SAPC), and Ultra Shield Technology to deliver safe, fresh-tasting drinking water. With its digital display, touch dispensing, and wall-mount or tabletop installation, the X2 Neo combines convenience, performance, and modern design for everyday use.

rows: 5-Stage UV Purification (SCB Max Combination Filter + Dual Pass UV + Silver Activated Post Carbon + Ultra Shield)
